recognize_zh: 低倍 CD21 免疫染色把整個淋巴結染出許多大而圓、邊界清楚、緊密排列的棕色結節，每一結節內都是擴大的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC）網，結節之間為陰性區；這種大量、擴大的 FDC 網狀大結節即結節性淋巴球為主型霍奇金淋巴瘤（NLPHL）的結節結構。
features: CD21 immunostain at low power highlighting numerous large, round to irregular, closely packed nodules
Each nodule contains an expanded, dense follicular dendritic cell meshwork with sharp to slightly frayed borders
Some nodules show a speckled pattern of small unstained holes within the meshwork (entrapped cells)
CD21-negative internodular zones between the nodules
Nodules replace most of the lymph node, with no normal-sized follicle pattern
describe_en: CD21 immunohistochemistry at low magnification highlights numerous large, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks forming closely packed nodules that replace most of the lymph node. The meshworks are dense and well-delineated, with small unstained spaces corresponding to entrapped lymphocytes and LP cells, separated by CD21-negative internodular areas. This macronodular pattern of expanded FDC networks is characteristic of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma in newer classification), typical pattern A/B.

ddx.vs: FL nodules are more numerous, smaller and back-to-back with CD10+/BCL2+ neoplastic centrocytes, rather than large nodules of small B cells containing scattered LP cells.
PTGC produces only a few enlarged nodules within an otherwise reactive node, whereas here nodules efface most of the architecture and contain LP cells.
Nodular LRCHL also has CD21+ meshworks, but the large cells are CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells located in expanded mantle zones, often with residual regressed germinal centers.
THRLBCL shows a diffuse pattern with loss of FDC meshworks, so extensive nodular CD21 staining argues against it.
